FN-EOEQ99-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 294
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/17/2023
Senate Bill 294 as introduced could increase personnel expenditures of state agencies by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional exempt employees hired by
state agencies as allowed by this bill and the compensation of those employees.
Page 1

FN-EOEQ99-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 294
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/30/2023
Senate Bill 294 as passed the Senate could increase personnel expenditures of state agencies by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the compensation of any additional exempt employees
hired by state agencies, as allowed by this bill.
